rationale: Builds on the reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a compact structural change: keep the decoder-output anchor fixed early, then gradually allow a small scheduled anchor refresh during the reverse recurrent tail. This spends extra recurrence capacity late, stays compile-stable, preserves the existing quant-aware/export path, and directly targets final int8 roundtrip behavior rather than another scalar-only sweep.
title: Late Scheduled Tail Anchor Refresh
